assessment.evidence: Nineteen ABBs, five views and ten decisions implement fail-closed admission, purpose, identity, access, analysis, review and transfer boundaries. The controls are stated as target logical outcomes, not certified or operating controls.

ABB-03, ABB-09, ABB-10 and ABB-18 cover minimisation, purpose, lawful-use evidence, legal holds, authoritative schedules, working-copy deletion and transfer gates. Exact schedules and approved locations remain open under VAL-004 and VAL-005.

SR-001, SR-002, SR-007 and SR-010 are preserved through ABB-10, ABB-11, ABB-12, ABB-15 and ABB-18. Phase 2 infers no Azure region and keeps foreign-jurisdiction exposure subject to General Counsel assessment and acceptance.

ABB-11 and AD-005 preserve controlled identities, authorised EU-based operation, least privilege, time-bound elevation, complete audit and emergency access. ABB-15 and AD-006 preserve separate environments and synthetic non-production data.

ABB-05 through ABB-08, ABB-10, ABB-12, ABB-16 and ABB-18 preserve assistive-only use, citations, prohibited actions, mandatory review, retained Investment Committee authority, no foundation-model training and independent validation. AI Act role and use-case classification remains open under AFFB-RES-001.

DORA remains an interim conditional evidence boundary under SR-009 and VAL-001 with no formal compliance claim. Neither high-risk nor non-high-risk EU AI Act status is asserted; classification is blocked pending accountable evidence.

ABB-12 through ABB-14 protect correlated evidence, alerting, incident ownership and consistent recoverable state. Availability, business-hour, pack and critical-alert definitions remain owner-bound under VAL-002.

Coverage revision 004 maps all 21 confirmed and four conditional obligation clusters to requirements, ABBs, decisions and views. Official citations, dates and article-level mappings remain open under AFFB-RES-002.
VAL-001 through VAL-005 and AFFB-RES-001/002 remain explicit, owner-bound, unwaived and linked to required-before points in the Markdown, catalogue, approval and coverage record.

The subject selects no SBB, Azure service, region, SKU, CIDR, module or implementation sequence and claims no deployment, runtime, certification, attestation or control operating-effectiveness evidence.

All 31 requirement IDs, 19 ABB IDs, five view IDs, ten decision IDs and seven residual-control IDs are represented consistently. The HTML is self-contained, has no external references or unsafe embedded objects, and materially reflects the authoritative Markdown and catalogue.

verdictRationale: No BLOCKER, MAJOR or MINOR finding was identified against the complete frozen ten-artifact Phase 2 subject. The architecture substantively implements the approved requirements as vendor-neutral logical controls and trust boundaries; preserves privacy, sovereignty, privileged access, human authority, independent Internal Audit validation, no foundation-model training, production isolation, incident evidence and resilience; keeps DORA and EU AI Act classification conditional; and carries all seven residual controls as owner-bound and unwaived. The retained legal-source, classification, location, source-detail and operational-definition gaps require a gap-qualified rather than unqualified conforming verdict.
